# Open-data fixture

Invented files in the formats of StatsBomb open data, IMPECT open data, football-data.co.uk
foul columns and the scan-rate study table. No figure is real. The builder tests overlay
this folder on `../real-targets`. The decoy competition-seasons 43_3 and 11_1 carry planted
values (xG 9.99 and 7.77, a 999 s carry) that no target may hold; 9_281 keeps the reference
fixture's matches file, which the blocked-shot check reads. `football-data/1718/D1.csv` is
held out and plants 99 fouls a side.
